title: Facing a mental health crisis, an NJ school pulled a beloved novel from English class
summary: Junot Díaz's The Brief Wondrous Life of Oscar Wao was removed from an English class at the public school. PEN America says it's part of a trend of scrubbing literature dealing with uncomfortable topics.
contentText:
The Brief Wondrous Life of Oscar Wao from the curriculum of a high-level English class at Columbia High School in Maplewood, N.J., in response to a mental health crisis.'/> Junot Díaz's The Brief Wondrous Life of Oscar Wao was removed from an English class at the public school.
